title: The Country Beyond the Summit Where Paths Forget Themselves

features.name: dusk-made-solid
features.desc-on-touch: the moment between paths and weather has crystallized here; you walk through sky bands of orange and purple that have weight and presence

features.name: the-last-markers
features.desc-on-touch: trail cairns dissolve as you watch, the stones sinking into the gradient as if the mountain is taking back its own boundaries

features.name: the-two-paths-becoming-weather
features.desc-on-touch: here both routes converge and lose their distinction—they dissolve into the same weather, equally wind and equally cloud

features.name: forgetting-monument
features.desc-on-touch: a standing stone inscribed with all the paths that led here—but the inscriptions fade as you read them, worn away by the wind of becoming weather

features.name: the-mist-that-was-a-horizon
features.desc-on-touch: what once was a distant landmark has become the air around you; the view you were walking toward is now the only thing you breathe

inscription: past the summit even the ground cannot remember which direction a path takes; only the weather knows where you are

file.name: Dusk_Summit_Gradient_Dissolving_Coordinates_Sequence.mp3
file.note: audio recording of a sunset observed from the peak transitioning into acoustically indistinguishable mist; time stretches in the gradient

exits.label: the descent back where the paths remember what they are
further into the mist where paths have forgotten they were ever separated
